derivation:
intro n R s hs Y k
  simpa [Function.Periodic] using (Function.Periodic.smul (fun Y => hf n R s hs Y k) (c n) Y)
explanation: For each fixed lattice shift k, the hypothesis gives Function.Periodic of the slice with period ((k.1 : ℝ), (k.2 : ℝ)). Applying Function.Periodic.smul with scalar c n and unfolding periodicity yields the desired equality; simp identifies real scalar multiplication with multiplication. The current proof instead uses congrArg directly.
